success_contract.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU using /app/isos/win311.img, with VNC on display :1 (port 5901), nginx on port 80 for web access, snapshot mode enabled, and QEMU configured for programmatic keyboard input; leave the VM running in the background at the Windows 3.11 desktop.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
VNC server reachable on port 5901 for display :1
nginx listening on port 80 serving a web interface for remote access
Evidence that QEMU accepts programmatic keyboard input beyond VNC-only interaction
required_behaviors: QEMU boots Windows 3.11 to the desktop
Base disk image remains immutable via snapshot mode
Keyboard input can be injected programmatically for automated testing
VM remains running in the background after setup
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or command success as sufficient without runtime behavior evidence
Using only VNC user interaction as the keyboard-control mechanism
Finalizing without receipt-backed evidence of the VM state and service reachability
Mutating the base disk image instead of using snapshot mode

Launch QEMU with the required VNC, snapshot, and keyboard-control configuration
Start or configure nginx on port 80 for web access
Verify QEMU process, VNC port 5901, nginx port 80, and programmatic keyboard input capability using receipts
Confirm the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop and remains running in the background
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and resulting running process
Receipt-backed evidence that VNC is bound to :1 / port 5901
Receipt-backed evidence that nginx is listening on port 80
Receipt-backed evidence demonstrating programmatic keyboard input support/configuration
